title: Esther made queen
summary: Esther is made queen (Esth 2:17). Jones places this in Darius’s seventh year.
description: Esther is made queen (Esth 2:17). Jones places this in Darius’s seventh year. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 515 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: CONFLICT: Jones prints AM 3490 and 515 BC. A derived check (not stored): 3490 + 515 = 4005, not 4004, against his rule that a BC number added to its AM counterpart yields 4004. Both figures are stored as printed (first-printed rule). Neither was adjusted. The sort uses the printed BC year.

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 21st ed. (Master Books, 2019), Appendix F, printed p. 280
chronologies.note: 21st ed. (2019) differs; the 23rd ed. (2026) sets the sort: 3490 AM, 515 BC.
